description: File browser with a plain-text editor.

folder.description: Absolute path, at most 8192 bytes, no NUL. Defaults to session directory on creation; successful navigation remembers the current folder.

editorFile.description: Absolute UTF-8 text file to reopen, at most 8192 bytes, no NUL. Opening/returning from the editor updates this field. Restores saved file contents, not unsaved edits.

notes: Browsing requires an accessible directory. Configuration does not create directories.
label: Files
